# Intent: <short title>

<!-- Written by /intent with Chris. Says why and for whom, not how. The planner turns it into spec.md and plan.md. -->

## Problem

Who has the problem, and what happens today.

## Outcome

What is true when this is done, in one or two sentences a user would recognise.

## Users and roles

Which tenants, users and roles (`requester`, `approver`) this touches.

## Constraints

Anything fixed: tenant isolation, cost (mock LLM provider by default), deadlines, things that must not change.

## Out of scope

What this intent deliberately does not include.

## Open questions

Decisions still open. The planner lists any it has to make under Assumptions.
